I read many reviews on this and other products- and I’m happy I chose this kit.  Its very easy to use, the gel is extremely workable, and this kit is affordable! This is a great kit for beginners. It has almost everything you need only thing missing is a cure light and you can easily purchase a cheap one here on amazon. I like this kit because it has a clear to incapsulate if your lookin to get fancy. It also has the cutes pink colors and a tan. For the price this is a steal, so far I have used it to fix a broken nail. It was quick and ubber easy to use. loving it.

reviews.t: Great even for someone that struggles to do nails!
reviews.x: This product works as well as advertised! I was skeptical at first, but after giving it a try I found it to be super easy to use and I have never been good at doing nails. I love that I can adjust the thickness of the nails to my preference. I’m hard on nails so I made mine a little on the thicker side.

So I tried this product for the first time and I like it... it was easy to follow and I can do my nails at home thanks to this easy to use product. It’s a little sticky but easy to apply. It comes with everything you need. I Would definitely purchase again.
first time user i loved the product would definitely buy again Very easy to use & work with I loved all the different color nudes and pinks !

It comes with everything else you need and it will take a long time before you run out of poly gel, considering you get 6 colors. reviews.t: No more nail salon, hello new nail kit!
reviews.x: This my first time trying poly gel. I am beyond surprised with how well I did. The poly gel is a little on the thick side and at first a little bit hard to work with. Once you get the hang of it it’s pretty easy. This kit comes with 6 different colors of gel, base coat, top coat, solution to help spread the poly gel,  nail file and a brush/spatula. Important- you need a UV/LED lamp to cure your poly gel. This kit overall is a great value. Definitely saving lots of trips to the nail shop and $$ t

reviews.t: Easy to follow and like the color
reviews.x: I liked the colors that are included and the instruction is easy follow.  It is easy to apply the nail form and I can easily adjust the length of nail extension gel. it looks good on my nail and it doesn't leave any major marks or scratches when i remove the extension. The product quality is good including free tools that they included.

I live how the nail industry is evolving just like any industry. Everything you need to do your nails is in the box. I purchased a small UV separately because i wanted it to dry faster. The colors are pretty and they last for a long time. So glad i tried this item.

I absolutely love this!! I’ve been looking for a polygel kit for what seems like forever! Now I have this omg, I can’t wait!! I have already looked at the forms, the black bar you see is the tool that I absolutely love!! Overall would 100000% buy this again!

reviews.t: Great brand, better than some more expensive brands I’ve tried!
reviews.x: I love this brand! The first time around I bought the monomer and powder which was better than other brands I’ve used. So I decided to try their poly gel and it did not disappoint. Very easy to work with and the colors are beautiful. Would purchase again!

reviews.t: MUST USE LED /Uv LAMP(Not Included in Kit)
reviews.x: This is a really good deal that comes with a variety of items needed to make your full set complete! However, the instructions on the box as well as the instructions included in the nail forms are not absolutely correct in perfect English. YOU MUST HAVE A LAMP! (UV/LED) My nails came out great and they’re pretty durable but you must follow the instructions like this: •CLIP/FILE NATURAL NAILS •USE 1 COAT of BASE COAT (included) •Put under LAMP 30seconds •CHOOSE NAIL FORM THAT FITS YOUR NAIL •SQUE

Many reviewers note the kit comes with almost everything needed, but several mention it does not include a UV/LED lamp.
Reviewers commonly praise the included colors, especially the nudes and pinks.
Several reviewers say the product is a good value and saves money compared to salon visits.
A few reviewers mention the gel is thick or sticky and takes some getting used to, while others note the included directions aren't great.
